name: Cells
description: A collection of Cell objects in a table column, table row, selection, or range.
remarks: Use the Cells property to return the Cells collection. The following example formats the cells in the first row in table one in the active document to be 30 points wide. The following example returns the number of cells in the current row. Use the Add method to add a Cell object to the Cells collection. You can also use the InsertCells method of the Selection object to insert new cells. The following example adds a cell before the first cell in myTable. Use Cell (row, column), where row is the row number and column is the column number, or Cells (_index_), where _index_ is the index number, to return a Cell object. The following example applies shading to the second cell in the first row in table one. The following example applies shading to the first cell in the first row. Remarks Use the Add method with the Rows or Columns collection to add a row or column of cells. The following example adds a column to the first table in the active document and then inserts numbers into the first column.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of items in the Cells collection. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Cells object.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns or sets the width of the table cells, in points. Read/write Single.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns or sets the height of the specified table cells. Read/write Single.

properties.name: HeightRule
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdRowHeightRule constant that represents the rule for determining the height of the specified cells. Read/write .

properties.name: VerticalAlignment
properties.description: Returns or sets the vertical alignment of text in one or more cells of a table. Read/write WdCellVerticalAlignment.

properties.name: Borders
properties.description: Returns a Borders collection that represents all the borders for the specified object.

properties.name: Shading
properties.description: Returns a Shading object that refers to the shading formatting for the specified object.

properties.name: NestingLevel
properties.description: Returns the nesting level of the specified cells. Read-only Long.

properties.name: PreferredWidth
properties.description: Returns or sets the preferred width (in points or as a percentage of the window width) for the specified cells. Read/write Single.

properties.name: PreferredWidthType
properties.description: Returns or sets the preferred unit of measurement to use for the width of the specified cells. Read-only WdPreferredWidthType.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual Cell object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned. Can be a Long indicating the ordinal position of the individual object.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Returns a Cell object that represents a cell added to a table.

parameters.name: BeforeCell
parameters.description: A Cell object that represents the cell that will appear immediately to the right of the new cell or cells.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a table cell or cells and optionally controls how the remaining cells are shifted.

parameters.name: ShiftCells
parameters.description: The direction in which the remaining cells are to be shifted. Can be any WdDeleteCells constant. If omitted, cells to the right of the last deleted cell are shifted left.

methods.name: SetWidth
methods.signature: SetWidth(ColumnWidth As Single, RulerStyle As WdRulerStyle)
methods.description: Sets the width of columns or cells in a table.

parameters.name: ColumnWidth
parameters.description: The width of the specified column or columns, in points.

parameters.name: RulerStyle
parameters.description: Controls the way Word adjusts cell widths.

methods.name: SetHeight
methods.signature: SetHeight(RowHeight As Variant, HeightRule As WdRowHeightRule)
methods.description: Sets the height of table cells.

parameters.name: RowHeight
parameters.description: The height of the row or rows, in points.

parameters.name: HeightRule
parameters.description: The rule for determining the height of the specified cells.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges the specified table cells with one another. The result is a single table cell.

methods.name: Split
methods.signature: Split([NumRows As Variant], [NumColumns As Variant], [MergeBeforeSplit As Variant])
methods.description: Splits a range of table cells.

parameters.name: NumRows
parameters.description: The number of rows that the cell or group of cells is to be split into.

parameters.name: NumColumns
parameters.description: The number of columns that the cell or group of cells is to be split into.

parameters.name: MergeBeforeSplit
parameters.description: True to merge the cells with one another before splitting them.

methods.name: DistributeHeight
methods.description: Adjusts the height of the specified cells so that they are equal.

methods.name: DistributeWidth
methods.description: Adjusts the width of the specified cells so that they are equal.

methods.name: AutoFit
methods.description: Changes the width of a table column to accommodate the width of the text without changing the way text wraps in the cells.
